{{Top}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Imperial Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]] had to defuse a '''baradium bomb''' that the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] had intended to use to destroy the [[Voss]] capital city of [[Voss-Ka]]. The Gormak built the device from scavenged hardware and copied the design from existing [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] bombs.<ref name="Gormak Disarmament">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|Gormak Disarmament|Voss}}</ref> Ultimately Cipher Nine was successful in preventing the destruction of Voss-Ka.
